## CreateRegistrationToken

`POST /spin.v1.RunnerTokenService/CreateRegistrationToken`

Generate a one-time registration token (admin only)

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | e.g., "Runner for host-us-east-1" |
| `teamId` | string | Optional: scope to team (host joins team's pool) |
| `expiresAt` | `Timestamp` | Default: 24h |
| `reusable` | boolean | A pool's token, for an autoscaling group whose machines register with nobody at them: it is not spent by the host it registers. Short-lived and rotated is the intended use. |
| `hostPolicy` | [HostPolicy](/reference/api/types/#hostpolicy) | The policy each host it registers starts with, under SetHostPolicy's rules; host_id must be empty, since the hosts do not exist yet. |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `tokenInfo` | [RegistrationToken](/reference/api/types/#registrationtoken) |  |
| `token` | string | Full token, shown only once |

## RevokeRunner

`POST /spin.v1.RunnerTokenService/RevokeRunner`

Revoke a runner (admin only)

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `hostId` | string |  |
| `leaveWorkspaces` | boolean | Revoke although workspaces are on this host. Refused without it: each such workspace can then run only once it is recovered onto another host (RecoverWorkspace), which gives up what this host had not published. A machine that may be compromised is revoked with it anyway. |

**Response**

No fields: `{}`.
